reason: The plugin is a DSH WebUI bundle that primarily enhances the chat interface by showing account-related display elements (real-time balance, session usage, per-message cost/cache rate) and provider branding, with an added settings tab for managing extra plugins. The host/client split and declared bundle in package.json plus documented host endpoints and imports in the README indicate a UI-facing enhancement and local plugin-management function, while also touching profile-level file mounts during plugin import/uninstall operations.

summaries.zh: uiopt 是一款 DSH WebUI 显示增强插件，提供会话区域的余额与每条消息消耗展示、缓存命中率与提供商图标，并在设置页支持额外插件导入与挂载管理。
summaries.en: uiopt is a DSH WebUI enhancement plugin that adds in-chat balance and per-message usage display, provider icons, and an extra-plugins import and mount management entry in settings.

capabilities: Injects custom UI into DSH WebUI slots for balance, per-message usage, and provider icon display
Exposes host routes used to read balance/context/plugin data for the UI
Performs plugin import flow that extracts and installs uploaded plugin packages into profile node_modules
Uses host-side provider credentials to query external service balance/usage-related information
Mutates local profile configuration by adding/removing patch mount entries
